messages:
gina_cs: flagging a month-end issue from Acme (invoice INV-2026-03-01). They say dashboard shows $9.2k but invoice is $11.5k. customer says no plan change. can we triage? :eyes:

raj_support: copying logs and invoice screenshot from customer — attaching PDFs in thread. any quick checks we should run?

acme_admin: we didn't touch anything on our side. billing dashboard numbers are what we monitor daily. invoice came through today and surprised us. invoice shows a retroactive tier bump on 03/01 00:05 UTC.

maria_finance: saw that too — invoice metadata has a field `tier_recompute=true` and `adjustment_reason=post_close_recompute`. normally dashboard snapshots should freeze tiers at cutoff.

devon_billing: can you paste the invoice JSON? also run the raw-metering query below to compare token counts vs aggregated tiering:```sql
-- raw tokens for customer for month
select event_time, model, tokens from raw_usage
where customer_id = 'acme-123' and event_time >= '2026-03-01' and event_time < '2026-04-01'
order by event_time limit 10;
```this will show if raw tokens changed or if the tiering job adjusted counts.

kwok_engineer: quick note from infra logs — background job `tiering-recompute` ran at 2026-03-01T00:05:12Z and processed ~1.2k accounts. There was a GC pause at 00:04 which delayed some upstream events; afterwards the job merged some previously-delayed usage records and re-evaluated tier boundaries. I suspect the dashboard snapshot happened before the merge but the invoice pipeline re-ran recompute later.

raj_support: that matches customer's timeline. dashboard snapshot = 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z, recompute at 00:05. so invoice captured post-merge tiers while dashboard did not.

devon_billing: repro steps for internal test: 1) create two usage events for same customer straddling cutoff (last-second and +2min). 2) force delayed ingestion path (inject small delay into kafka consumer). 3) trigger tiering-recompute. 4) compare /dash/snapshots vs invoice pipeline output. curl examples:```bash
# publish late event
curl -X POST https://ingest.redwood/api/usage -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" -d '{"customer_id":"acme-123","tokens":1200,"timestamp":"2026-03-01T00:01:30Z"}'
```should produce a different invoice if recompute runs after snapshot.

maria_finance: for remediation we can either: a) issue a credit memo for affected invoice lines, or b) backfill the dashboard snapshots so they match invoice (risky). recommending issuing credit memos for impacted accounts and patching snapshot locking.

kwok_engineer: agree. short-term: issue credits. longer-term: patch to ensure end-of-period snapshot locks usages and ignores recompute merges after cutoff unless explicitly reconciled. I'll open a PR for snapshot-lock behavior.

acme_admin: ETA on credits? customer is unhappy and compliance needs the explanation.

maria_finance: i'll generate a credit memo template and apply it to INV-2026-03-01 for the delta (~$2.3k). need approval from finance manager, should be <24h.

devon_billing: i'll add automated tests to prevent recompute after cutoff and a smoke test that compares invoice vs snapshot totals during CI. adding the test cases to the billing repo.

gina_cs: action items: @maria_finance create credit memo and notify Acme; @kwok_engineer open PR for snapshot-lock; @devon_billing add CI smoke tests and repro docs. i'll update customer with plan and ETA. tagging @invoicing-bot to create incident link. :thumbsup:

invoicing-bot: incident created: INC-2026-03-101 — post-close tier recompute affecting invoices.

gina_cs: thanks all — please post updates here once credits applied and PR merged.
